targets.expr: go_memstats_mallocs_total{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} - go_memstats_frees_total{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}

sum(rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container="robin"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod) / clamp_min(sum(rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container="robin"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod), 0.000001)
